limitations: One adult male reference model; not patient-specific anatomy.
Skin is an uncapped torso-region crop of the real whole-body mesh and can include proximal arms.
Heart mesh includes ventricular and atrial walls; valve, coronary and great-vessel details are omitted.
Lungs are the sourced bronchopulmonary parenchymal segment surfaces, not a reconstructed outer hull.
Lymph node geometry was not found in the selected BodyParts3D manifest and is not fabricated; spleen is supplied as a real immune organ.
Quadratic-error decimation removes geometric detail; meshes are educational display assets, not clinical measurements.
